en.headline: Eleven bus and five minibus routes diverted for Pok Fu Lam fire dragon
en.dek: Police will close a stretch of Wah Fu Road near Wah Lok House from about 10.30pm to 11.45pm for the Mid-Autumn parade.
body: The Transport Department said 11 franchised bus routes and five green minibus routes will be diverted on Mid-Autumn night for the Pok Fu Lam fire dragon parade. Police will temporarily close a section of Wah Fu Road near Wah Lok House at Wah Fu (I) Estate from about 10.30pm to 11.45pm.

Stops along Wah Fu Road and Pok Fu Lam Road will be suspended or moved during the closure. The department said it and the police will watch traffic in Southern District and adjust the plan if crowds build. Drivers were told to follow on-site signs.

The department asked passengers to check operator notices, the Transport Department website, or the HKeMobility app before travelling. Separate Mid-Autumn road closures are also in force in Tai Hang and other festival sites across the city.

zh.headline: 薄扶林舞火龍今晚封路 11條巴士5條小巴改道
zh.dek: 警方約晚上10時30分至11時45分臨時封閉華富（一）邨華樂樓附近一段華富道，南區多條路線調整站位。
body: 運輸署表示，為配合中秋節薄扶林舞火龍，警方今晚約10時30分至11時45分將臨時封閉華富（一）邨華樂樓附近一段華富道，11條專營巴士及5條專線小巴路線須改道並調整站位。
華富道及薄扶林道沿線部分巴士站會暫停或臨時遷移。運輸署及警方會留意南區交通，必要時再作調整，駕駛人士須遵從現場指示。
署方呼籲乘客出發前查閱營辦商通告、運輸署網頁或「香港出行易」應用程式。大坑及其他賞月地點今晚亦有節慶封路安排。
